description: benchbox/core/tpch/streams.py:234 passes `-p stream_id + 1` to qgen, while the Python permutation path indexes PERMUTATION_MATRIX[stream_id] (streams.py:202). The two paths disagree on which permutation a stream uses. _generate_stream_queries_qgen (line 204) is dead code today, so nothing is wrong at runtime, but it would produce the wrong ordering if wired in. Decide whether to delete the dead method or align the indexing, and prove the choice with a test.
